changeSet.author: xiezm
changeSet.comment: 软下线数据架构迁移后遗留在“数据建模 / 数仓规划”下的公共层、应用层空父节点， 避免两个无独立目标的菜单入口落到同一规划页面；原菜单行和旧深链继续保留以支持回滚与兼容访问。
changeSet.sql:
DO $do$ DECLARE actor CONSTANT VARCHAR := 'sprint87-retire-modeling-layer-groups'; BEGIN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('dts:portal-menu:retire-modeling-layer-groups:20260810-02', 0));
WITH RECURSIVE orphaned_groups AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE deleted = FALSE AND ( name IN ( 'sys.nav.portal.planningPublicLayer', 'sys.nav.portal.planningApplicationLayer' ) OR metadata::jsonb ->> 'key' IN ('planning-public', 'planning-application') OR metadata::jsonb ->> 'titleKey' IN ( 'sys.nav.portal.planningPublicLayer', 'sys.nav.portal.planningApplicationLayer' ) ) UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM portal_menu child JOIN orphaned_groups parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.deleted = FALSE ) UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = TRUE, last_modified_by = actor || '-retired', last_modified_date = now() WHERE deleted = FALSE AND id IN (SELECT id FROM orphaned_groups); END $do$;
